scans.ci.status.failing.description: The last run on the default branch failed the CI gate.
scans.ci.status.degraded.description: Scanners failed in the last run, or the runner is older than the minimum supported version.
scans.ci.status.stale.description: No run within its expected cadence: two missed scheduled cycles, or three times its usual interval.
scans.ci.status.fresh.description: It ran within its expected cadence.
scans.ci.status.never.description: Registered, but no run of its own yet (only fork runs, or backfilled).
scans.ci.status.archived.description: Idle for 90 days. Nothing is deleted; the next run brings it back.
scans.ci.status.retired.description: An administrator retired it and the findings only it reported were closed. The next run brings it back.
scans.ci.status.revoked.description: Its trust configuration was disabled, deleted or changed. The next admitted run brings it back.
scans.ci.reason.secret_pre_existing: Secret already on the default branch
scans.ci.feedback.description: OpenCTEM posts each verdict as the "OpenCTEM gate" check (GitHub) or commit status (GitLab) and keeps one comment on the pull or merge request. The check of a commit takes the strictest verdict of every pipeline on it. Make the check required in branch protection and set its expected source to the OpenCTEM app: any other source, such as a workflow's own token, could post a check with the same name.
scans.ci.feedback.githubConfigured: Install the app on the GitHub organizations whose repositories send results. It can post checks and pull request comments, and read nothing else.
scans.ci.feedback.githubMissing: This deployment has no GitHub App yet. An operator registers it; then install it here.
scans.ci.feedback.gitlabDescription: A group access token (Developer role, api scope) lets OpenCTEM set the commit status and comment on merge requests of the group. A personal access token is refused. The token is stored encrypted and never shown again.
scans.ci.feedback.removeGitlab: The stored token is deleted. Runs no longer set the commit status or comment there.
scans.ci.feedback.removeGithub: Runs no longer post checks or comments there. The app stays installed on GitHub until someone removes it there.
scans.ci.feedback.gitlabDialog: GitLab must confirm the token is active, has the api scope and belongs to the group. You confirm with your second factor.
scans.ci.callback.missing: GitHub did not send the installation details.
scans.ci.callback.title: GitHub App installation
scans.ci.callback.done: Installed on {account}. CI runs of its repositories now post the OpenCTEM gate check and a pull request comment.
scans.ci.callback.requested: GitHub sent the install request to an owner of the organization. Come back here after they approve it.
scans.ci.callback.back: Back to CI trust and gate

scans.groups.proofIntrusiveHint: Intrusive checks need a verified domain of your organization on every sensor. Verify the domain, or remove these targets.
scans.groups.proofHint: The platform's shared sensors scan only domains your organization verified. Run the scan on your own sensor, verify the domain, or remove these targets.
scans.groups.platformHint: Only bug-bounty program entries cover these targets. Run the scan on your own sensor, or remove them.
scans.groups.zoneHint: Scanning an internal address would hit your own network, so a scan zone must say which of your sensors may reach it.
scans.groups.entryHint: The scope entry exists, but it does not authorize scans until it is in effect.
scans.groups.scopeHint: No scope entry covers these targets for this kind of scan. Add them in Scoping, or remove them.
scans.groups.ownershipHint: Your organization excluded these names, or their ownership waits for review.
scans.groups.accessHint: You may scan only the assets in your data scope.
scans.groups.invalidHint: These targets cannot be scanned. Remove them.
scans.groups.resolvesTo: Resolves to {addr}, an internal address: scanning it would hit your own network.
scans.groups.isInternal: {addr} is an internal address: scanning it would hit your own network.
scans.groups.noZone: No scan zone covers this target.
scans.routing.ownBecauseProof: runs on your sensor {name}, because platform sensors need a verified domain
scans.routing.busy: waits for one of your sensors (all are busy)
scans.routing.internal: waits for one of your sensors: private targets never go to platform sensors
scans.routing.waits: waits: none of your sensors that run this scan is online
scans.review.skipRefused: Scan the {count} allowed targets, skip the rest
scans.failure.unknown: Code {code}: this console does not describe it yet.
scans.failure.SCANNER_NOT_FOUND.text: The sensor does not have the step's tool.
scans.failure.SCANNER_NOT_FOUND.fix: Install the tool on a sensor, or pick a sensor that reports it.
scans.failure.TARGET_REFUSED.text: The sensor's target guard refused a target.
scans.failure.TARGET_REFUSED.fix: Check the target and the sensor's local policy.
scans.failure.NO_TARGETS.text: The step had nothing to scan.
scans.failure.NO_TARGETS.fix: Check the scan's targets and the scope.
scans.failure.NO_SENSOR.text: No sensor took the work before the run's deadline.
scans.failure.NO_SENSOR.fix: Bring a sensor online that can take it; the waiting reasons on its tasks say which.
scans.failure.COMMAND_EXHAUSTED.text: The task was handed out the maximum number of times and never finished.
scans.failure.COMMAND_EXHAUSTED.fix: Check the sensor's logs for the task; run the scan again when the cause is fixed.
scans.failure.NO_MATCHING_TOOL.text: No tool can run this step's capability.
scans.failure.NO_MATCHING_TOOL.fix: Edit the step: pick a capability a tool runs, or another tool.
The step's capability matches several stages.
Edit the step and name the capability exactly.
scans.failure.INCOMPATIBLE_TARGETS.text: The step's tool cannot scan any of the run's target types.
scans.failure.INCOMPATIBLE_TARGETS.fix: Edit the step or the scan's targets.
scans.failure.STAGE_NOT_CHAINABLE.text: This step cannot take what the previous step produced.
scans.failure.STAGE_NOT_CHAINABLE.fix: Edit the workflow's links between steps.
scans.failure.STEP_TARGETS_REFUSED.text: Every target of the step was refused by the scope.
scans.failure.STEP_TARGETS_REFUSED.fix: Add the targets to the scope, or change the scan's targets.
scans.failure.ALL_TARGETS_EXCLUDED.text: Every target is excluded from the scope.
scans.failure.ALL_TARGETS_UNCONFIRMED.te: No target is confirmed as the organization's.
scans.failure.ALL_TARGETS_UNCONFIRMED.fi: Confirm the targets in Scoping first.
scans.failure.NO_SENSOR_FOR_TOOL.text: No sensor offers the step's tool.
scans.failure.NO_SENSOR_FOR_TOOL.fix: Install a sensor with the tool, or let a sensor report it.
scans.failure.NO_SENSOR_AVAILABLE.text: No sensor was online when the step started.
scans.failure.POLICY_REFUSED.text: A sensor's local policy refused the work.
scans.failure.POLICY_REFUSED.fix: The owner of the scanned network reviews the sensor's local policy.
scans.failure.FREEZE_WINDOW.text: A scan freeze was in effect.
scans.failure.FREEZE_WINDOW.fix: Wait for the freeze to end, or review the scan windows.
scans.failure.COMMAND_FAILED.text: The task failed on the sensor.
scans.failure.COMMAND_FAILED.fix: Open the task's logs for the sensor's message.
scans.failure.COMMAND_EXPIRED.text: No sensor took the task before it expired.
scans.failure.COMMAND_EXPIRED.fix: Bring a sensor online that can take it.
scans.failure.LEASE_LOST.text: The sensor stopped reporting while it ran the task.
scans.failure.LEASE_LOST.fix: Check that the sensor is online and healthy; a retry may succeed.
scans.failure.TOOL_EXIT.text: The tool exited with an error.
scans.failure.TOOL_EXIT.fix: Open the task's logs for the tool's output.
scans.failure.PARSE_ERROR.text: The tool's output could not be read.
scans.failure.PARSE_ERROR.fix: Open the task's logs; the tool version may not match the sensor.
scans.failure.TIMEOUT.text: The step ran out of time.
scans.failure.TIMEOUT.fix: Raise the step's timeout or narrow its targets.
scans.failure.CANCELED.text: A person or the run's deadline stopped the step.
scans.failure.CANCELED.fix: Run the scan again when needed.
scans.failure.BATCH_FAILED.text: Every part of the step failed.
scans.failure.BATCH_FAILED.fix: Open the tasks' logs for each part's error.
scans.failure.QUEUE_ERROR.text: The step could not be queued.
scans.failure.QUEUE_ERROR.fix: Run the scan again; if it repeats, check the platform's logs.
scans.failure.SCOPE_CHANGED.text: The scope changed while the task waited, and no target may be scanned now.
scans.failure.SCOPE_CHANGED.fix: Review the scope and run the scan again.
scans.failure.GATE_RECORD_MISSING.text: The task was queued without the record its targets are checked against.
scans.failure.SIGNER_REFUSED.text: The job signer refused the task: the scope ledger does not authorize it.
scans.failure.INTENSITY_EXCEEDED.text: The task probes harder than the scan's intensity allows.
scans.failure.INTENSITY_EXCEEDED.fix: Raise the scan's intensity or edit the step.
scans.failure.WEB_SCOPE_UNSUPPORTED.text: The sensor's tool cannot keep to the web scope (a path excluded on the host).
scans.failure.WEB_SCOPE_UNSUPPORTED.fix: Run the sensor with its seccomp profile so its tools are network-confined, or use a sensor that is.
scans.failure.NO_CONFINED_SENSOR.text: This step has a web scope, and its tool keeps to one only on a sensor whose tool network is confined. No sensor of the organization reports that.
scans.failure.NO_CONFINED_SENSOR.fix: Run a sensor with its seccomp profile (the install commands include it).
scans.placement.expired.text: The task expired before a sensor took it.
scans.placement.window_closed.text: It waits for its scan window to open.
scans.placement.window_closed.fix: It starts by itself when the window opens.
scans.placement.host_busy.text: Another task is scanning one of its hosts.
scans.placement.host_busy.fix: It starts when that task ends.
scans.placement.inactive.text: The sensor is disabled or revoked.
scans.placement.inactive.fix: Enable the sensor, or use another one.
scans.placement.offline.fix: Start the sensor or check its connection.
scans.placement.pinned_elsewhere.text: The task is reserved for another sensor.
scans.placement.refused_earlier.text: The sensor already refused this task.
scans.placement.outside_zone.text: The sensor is not in the task's scan zone, or lacks the tool there.
scans.placement.outside_zone.fix: Assign a sensor with the tool to the zone.
scans.placement.tool_missing.text: The sensor did not report the tool as installed.
scans.placement.tool_missing.fix: Install the tool on the sensor.
scans.placement.capability_missing.text: The sensor does not offer a capability the task requires.
scans.placement.capability_missing.fix: Use a sensor that offers it.
scans.placement.not_confined.text: The task needs a sensor whose tool network is confined (a web scope), and this sensor does not report it.
scans.placement.not_confined.fix: Run the sensor with its seccomp profile (the install commands include it).
scans.placement.grant.text: The sensor's grant does not allow it ({dimension}).
scans.placement.grant.fix: Widen the sensor's grant, or use another sensor.
scans.placement.intensity.text: On this sensor the task probes harder than the scan's intensity.
scans.placement.intensity.fix: Raise the scan's intensity, or use another sensor.
scans.placement.policy_unavailable.text: The sensor's grant or policy could not be read, so nothing goes to it for now.
scans.placement.policy_unavailable.fix: Retry shortly; if it lasts, check the platform's logs.
scans.placement.private_needs_local_poli: The task has private targets, and the organization requires a sensor-local policy for them.
Install a local policy on the sensor.
scans.placement.opt_in_disabled.text: The task uses an option the organization has not enabled (callbacks or custom templates).
scans.placement.opt_in_disabled.fix: Enable the option for sensors, or change the scan.
scans.placement.local_policy_refuses.tex: The sensor's local policy refuses the task.
scans.placement.local_policy_refuses.fix: The owner of the scanned network reviews the policy.
scans.placement.no_free_slot.text: The sensor runs as many scans as it can.
scans.placement.no_free_slot.fix: It takes the task when a slot frees up.
scans.placement.loadFailed: Could not check why this task waits.
scans.placement.heldForAll: It is held whatever the sensor:
scans.placement.allBusy: Sensors that can take it: {count}, all busy now. It starts when one frees up.
scans.placement.someCan: Sensors that can take it: {count} ({busy} busy). It should start shortly.
scans.placement.noneCan: None of the {count} sensors can take it:
scans.placement.truncated: Only the first sensors by name were checked.
scans.placement.unknown: Reason {code}: this console does not describe it yet.
scans.failure.TARGET_UNREACHABLE.text: The sensor could not reach the step's targets (no route, a filter refused it, every attempt timed out, or the names did not resolve in its network).
scans.failure.TARGET_UNREACHABLE.fix: Run the step from a sensor that can reach the targets: assign one to the targets' scan zone.
scans.owner.title: No active owner
scans.owner.missing: This scan has no owner: the account that created it no longer exists.
scans.owner.inactive: This scan's owner is no longer an active member.
scans.owner.scheduledEffect: Its scheduled runs act as the owner, so they are refused and the scan is paused until someone takes ownership.
scans.owner.manualEffect: Anyone who may run it can still start it by hand; a schedule needs an owner.
scans.owner.taken: You now own "{name}". Resume it to restart its schedule.
scans.owner.askAdmin: An owner or administrator can take ownership.
scans.runDetail.deadlineReason.scan_max_: Set by this scan's max duration. Slow but active work is not cut before it.
scans.runDetail.deadlineReason.workflow_: Set by the workflow's timeout setting.
scans.runDetail.deadlineReason.platform_: No max duration is set: the platform's 24 h cap applies, only as a backstop against runs that never end.
scans.runDetail.deadlineReason.legacy: Set when the run started, by the scan's timeout at that time.
scans.failure.DEADLINE_TOO_CLOSE.text: Not started: too little time was left before the run's deadline for this step to do anything useful.
scans.failure.DEADLINE_TOO_CLOSE.fix: Its targets roll over to the next scheduled run. Raise or clear the scan's max duration if the run should finish in one go.
scans.failure.NO_COMPATIBLE_TARGETS.text: No target suits the scan's scanner.
scans.failure.NO_COMPATIBLE_TARGETS.fix: Pick a scanner for these targets (a network range goes to port scans and host discovery), or change the targets in Edit.
scans.failure.TIER_EXCEEDS.text: The scope entries covering the targets allow less than this scanner probes.
scans.failure.TIER_EXCEEDS.fix: Raise the entry's tier in Scoping > Targets, or use a less intrusive scanner.
scans.failure.INTERNAL_TARGET_OUTSIDE_ZO: Internal addresses outside every scan zone.
Add the ranges to a scan zone in Settings > Scan zones.
scans.failure.NO_RESOLVING_TARGETS.text: No target name has resolved recently.
scans.failure.NO_RESOLVING_TARGETS.fix: Their DNS is being checked again: run the scan later, or scan addresses.
scans.failure.LIVENESS_NEEDS_HOST_DISCOV: Live hosts first needs a Host discovery step.
Add a Host discovery step to the workflow, use the Network workflow, or sweep the whole range.
scans.failure.SCAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.tex: This scan needs an approval before it runs.
scans.failure.SCAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.fix: Submit it for approval on the scan's page.
scans.failure.SCAN_APPROVAL_PENDING.text: This scan is waiting for approval.
scans.failure.SCAN_APPROVAL_PENDING.fix: It runs once an approver approves it; see the approval panel on the scan's page.
scans.tasks.stalling: No target finished for {quiet}; taken back as stalled after {stall}
scans.dynamic.livenessSuggestionHint: This scan sweeps every address of its ranges. It can find the live hosts first and scan only those and the addresses your inventory knows.
scans.dynamic.cidrModeNoticeSaved: No choice saved: this scan sweeps every address of its ranges, and keeps doing so until you choose otherwise.
scans.liveness.title: Live hosts first (recommended)
scans.liveness.hintWorkflow: This scan sweeps every address of its ranges. Its workflow has a Host discovery step, so it can find the live hosts first and scan only those and the addresses your inventory knows.
scans.liveness.hintScanner: This scan sweeps every address of its ranges. It can find the live hosts first and scan only those and the addresses your inventory knows.
scans.liveness.switched: The scan now finds live hosts first
scans.liveness.switchFailed: The scan could not be switched
scans.ci.setup.title: Connect a pipeline
scans.ci.setup.description: Pipelines report with their own short-lived identity: nothing secret goes into CI.
scans.ci.setup.ownersHint: Comma separated. Only pipelines of these may report; you can narrow by repository and branch later.
scans.ci.setup.snippetHint: Add this to the pipeline of a repository it admits and push a commit or open a pull request.
scans.ci.setup.defaultBranchHint: Pushes to this branch are scanned in full and become the baseline that pull requests are compared with.
scans.ci.setup.reused: The trust configuration "{name}" already admits these pipelines, so nothing new was created. Use its snippet in every repository.
scans.ci.setup.snippetHintGithub: Save this as .github/workflows/openctem.yml in a repository it admits, then push a commit or open a pull request.
scans.ci.setup.askAdmin: Ask an administrator to connect a pipeline.
scans.ci.refusals.title: Recent refused pipelines
scans.ci.refusals.description: Pipelines whose identity no trust configuration admitted, with the rule that refused each one.
scans.ci.refusals.none: No pipeline has been refused recently.
scans.ci.refusal.no_matching_configurati: No trust configuration exists for this CI provider or issuer.
Create a trust configuration for this provider (Connect a pipeline).
scans.ci.refusal.missing_claims: The token lacks the repository, commit, ref or id.
scans.ci.refusal.missing_claimsFix: Run the scan in a pipeline job of the repository, not a manual or detached job.
scans.ci.refusal.owner_not_allowed: The repository's organization is not in the trust configuration.
scans.ci.refusal.owner_not_allowedFix: Add the organization to Owners, or check the spelling.
scans.ci.refusal.repository_not_allowed: The repository is not in the trust configuration's repositories.
scans.ci.refusal.repository_not_allowedF: Add the repository (or a pattern that covers it).
scans.ci.refusal.ref_not_allowed: The branch or tag is not in the allowed refs.
scans.ci.refusal.ref_not_allowedFix: Add the branch to Refs, or leave Refs empty to allow every branch.
scans.ci.refusal.ref_not_protected: The configuration requires a protected branch and this one is not.
scans.ci.refusal.ref_not_protectedFix: Protect the branch in the code host, or turn off the protected-branch rule.
scans.ci.refusal.environment_not_allowed: The job's deployment environment is not allowed.
Add the environment, or run the scan in an allowed one.
scans.ci.refusal.event_not_allowed: The pipeline event (push, pull request, schedule) is not allowed.
scans.ci.refusal.event_not_allowedFix: Add the event to Events, or leave Events empty.
scans.ci.refusal.fork_pull_request: The run comes from a pull request from a fork.
scans.ci.refusal.fork_pull_requestFix: Fork runs are refused by design; they scan without reporting. Allow forks only if you accept their results.
scans.ci.refusal.workflow_not_allowed: The pipeline definition is not one of the allowed central workflows.
scans.ci.refusal.workflow_not_allowedFix: Use the organization's central workflow, or add its path and ref to Pipeline definitions.
scans.ci.refusal.organization_mismatch: The token's organization is not the configured one.
scans.ci.refusal.organization_mismatchFi: Check the organization id or workspace in the trust configuration.
scans.ci.refusal.owner_id_mismatch: The organization name now belongs to a different organization than the one first trusted.
scans.ci.refusal.owner_id_mismatchFix: If the organization was really recreated, re-pin it in the trust configuration.
scans.ci.refusal.repository_binding: The repository name is bound to a different repository that reported first.
scans.ci.refusal.repository_bindingFix: If the repository was recreated, retire its old pipeline first.
scans.ci.refusal.pipeline_identity: The token does not identify the pipeline.
scans.ci.refusal.pipeline_identityFix: Use a supported CI provider job with its OIDC token.
scans.ci.refusal.ssh_rerun: The job is a re-run with SSH access.
scans.ci.refusal.replay: The same token was used twice.
scans.ci.refusal.replayFix: Each job must exchange its own fresh token; check for copied tokens.
scans.ci.refusal.runner_outdated: The CI scanner is older than the minimum version.
scans.ci.refusal.runner_outdatedFix: Pin openctemio/ci v0.3.0 or later. The job log names the exact line to change (GitHub uses:, GitLab include, or the image tag).
scans.ci.refusal.pipeline_cap: The organization reached its number of pipelines.
scans.ci.refusal.pipeline_rate: This pipeline started too many runs in a short time.
scans.ci.refusal.pipeline_rateFix: Wait and retry; check for a loop in the pipeline.
scans.ci.refusal.run_mismatch: The job named a run of another pipeline.
scans.ci.refusal.run_mismatchFix: Let each pipeline run use its own run.
scans.ci.refusal.aggregate_no_run_id: A combined run needs the pipeline's run id, which the token does not carry.
scans.ci.refusal.aggregate_no_run_idFix: Run one job per capability without combining, or use a provider that names the run.
scans.ci.runDetail.monitored: {count} more in monitor mode (recorded, not listed).
scans.placement.sensor_hosts_busy.text: The sensor that took it is still scanning one of its hosts, so it handed the task back.
scans.placement.sensor_hosts_busy.fix: It runs when that host is free on that sensor, or on another sensor.
scans.placement.hostWait: Waiting: {held} of its {total} hosts are being scanned by another task. It starts when those hosts are free.
scans.placement.hostWaitFree: {base} {canStart} of its {targets} targets are on free hosts.
scans.placement.hostWaitTool: Waiting: {held} of its {total} hosts are being scanned by {tool}. It starts when those hosts are free.
scans.placement.hostWaitBy: Waiting: {held} of its {total} hosts are being scanned by {tool} (step {step}). It starts when those hosts are free.
scans.tasks.hostWaitBy: Waiting for {held} of its hosts, held by {tool} (step {step}, {where})
scans.tasks.hostWaitTool: Waiting for {held} of its hosts, held by {tool}
scans.tasks.hostWaitAny: Waiting for {held} of its hosts, held by another task
scans.tasks.hostWaitWithFree: {base}; {canStart} of its {targets} targets are on free hosts
scans.tasks.waitingForHosts: Waiting for its hosts: another task is scanning them
scans.tasks.handedBackHostsBusy: Handed back: its sensor is still scanning one of its hosts
scans.toolOption.opengrep: Static application security testing (SAST) with local rules only
scans.toolOption.betterleaks: Secret detection in code, git history and archives (replaces Gitleaks)
scans.ci.refusal.legacy_audience: The pipeline used the trust configuration's old audience, which it may no longer use.
scans.ci.refusal.legacy_audienceFix: Update the pipeline to the current snippet: its audience names the organization (openctem:tenant:<id>).
scans.ci.trust.legacyAudience: Pipelines that existed before may still use the old audience {value} until {until}, until they use the new one once. Update their pipeline to the current snippet.
